marta: Quick handoff — I'm wrapping up the canary prep for api-generate v3.2. Deploy scheduled 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (canary 10% -> 50% over ~2h). Changing throttle policy from dynamic-burst -> steady-rate to reduce cold-surge risk. Leaving watchers: @liam, @suresh, @olivia. Expected risk: small clients might see transient 429s during first hour. If 429 > 2% sustained for 5m, rollback to v3.1. Runbook + metrics dashboard linked: https://internal.redwood/in/rollouts/3.2 :point_up:

marta: rollout config (quick):
```
rollout:
  type: canary
  steps:
    - percent: 10
      duration: 30m
    - percent: 50
      duration: 90m
throttle_policy: steady-rate(100rps)
fallback: v3.1
autoscaler_min: 3
```

liam: ack — I'll be primary watcher from 02:45-06:00 UTC. I'll keep short pings here. Any quick smoke tests you want me to run? :eyes:

marta: thanks. smoke tests: 1) health: `curl -sS -H "x-api-key: $SMOKE_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v3/health` should return ok
2) basic gen: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}'`
3) auth + cost header present on responses. If any fail, mark canary as failed and rollback.

suresh: noted. infra notes: autoscaler min stays 3; I'll keep an eye on node CPU and pod eviction events. If p95 latency > 300ms for 10m I'll scale +2 and page oncall (pager rule: latency-high). I'll add a short-lived alert for 60m around the window.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: service=api-generate, version=v3.2, start=2026-04-02T03:00:00Z. CI: passed. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary-v3.2

olivia: I can cover 04:00-07:00 UTC if extra hands needed. Confirming fallback model pinned and console rollback available?

marta: confirmed — fallback v3.1 pinned and automated fallback configured if error rate > 5% for 3m. Rollback CLI: `redwoodctl rollback --service api-generate --to v3.1` or use Console -> Deployments -> api-generate -> Rollback. Ping me on mobile @marta_mobile for urgent stuff.

liam: one more: cache warming — want a pre-rollout warm at 02:40 UTC to seed KV caches. I'll trigger `jobs/warm-caches --service api-generate --mode=prompt-sample` at 02:40.

marta: done — cache job scheduled for 02:40. Playbook updated with contingency steps and contact list. Closing handoff, leaving this thread live for pings during the window. :thumbsup:

liam: thanks — will report first-10min smoke + 30m snapshot here.

suresh: I'll post infra snapshot at 03:15 and 04:15. Good luck all.
